scope: Development comparison of marker pose estimation on the same marked non-anatomical sheet. No endpoint relabel, holdout use, or M5 acceptance.
measurement: Instead of treating depth samples as isotropic points, fit the visible intersection of each camera ray with the known-radius marker sphere. Use one fixed robust loss scale (0.5 mm) for all inputs, irrespective of injected noise. Keep the original component, sample, depth outlier and 0.3 mm rigid-fit RMS checks; require the original rigid fit AND the ray-based fit to pass. Missing or nonfinite fits are invalid. No changes to slit evidence, material chart, calibration, closure or sweep guards, motion budgets or optics.
paired_replay: Replay the recorded v1.9.1 nominal and noisy vision captures with their original per-tick RNG draws, no holdouts. Report common-valid and rejected counts, tip error median/p95/max, jaw angle, and per-closure tip error. Proceed to live development only if the ray fit reduces both noisy common-frame median and p95 tip error, does not promote any previously invalid pose, retains at least 80 percent of previously valid poses in each capture and keeps the nominal common-frame median below 1 mm. This tests only the marker hypothesis; no endpoint inference.
live: If the paired gate passes, repeat marked truth, marked vision nominal (seed 0) and 0.5 mm depth noise (seed 1) using v1.9.1 configuration plus ray_marker_fit=true. Diagnostic ECM +4.5 deg yaw, 0 pitch, insertion 0.080 m. Report 17-tick truth identity, closures, actual growth, reacquisitions, peak and terminal length, faults, tears and 9-10 mm completion with withdrawal. Keep the v1.9 default and all signed gates unchanged.
